concerns.text: FR-001 requires generation of visual layout latents using a frozen visual encoder, but the only task that adds a latent vector is T003, which produces deterministic *structural* features. No task creates visual‑layout latents, so the functional requirement is not satisfied.

FR-002 mandates training a DistilledModel to predict the visual (or structural) latents for downstream use. Task T005 is explicitly limited to a “sanity‑check only” distillation and does not produce a full student model for downstream evaluation, leaving the requirement unmet.

The implementation plan (plan.md) states that a fixed seed count of 10 (seeds 42‑51) must be used for robust paired testing. All downstream tasks (T005‑T009) are defined with only three seeds (42‑44), so the plan element is not realized by any task.
